workflows.name: Clinician Session Confirmation and Rostering
workflows.trigger: People & Culture sends new clinician details to Clinical Services at least ten business days before the start date.
workflows.why: Session confirmation and roster handoffs are currently coordinated across separate communications manually. Automating this step ensures session details are promptly confirmed and forwarded to operations without delay.

evidence.quote: When a clinician accepts an offer, the HR Advisor checks their registration and sends the new clinician's details to Clinical Services at least ten business days before the start date.
The Clinical Director confirms the clinician's sessions and sends a roster request to Practice Operations, which adds the clinician to the clinic rosters and the booking system.

workflows.name: Purchasing and Equipment Approval
workflows.trigger: A Practice Coordinator raises a purchase request with the item, clinic, cost including GST, and reason.
workflows.why: Purchase requests require tiered sign-offs across multiple managers depending on item type and value. Automating the workflow routes approvals seamlessly based on financial thresholds and clinical requirements.

evidence.quote: A Practice Coordinator raises a purchase request with the item, the clinic, the cost including GST and the reason. The Operations Manager confirms the need. Clinical equipment also needs the Clinical Director's sign-off.
Over $5,000 and up to $25,000 Operations Manager and Finance Manager
Over $25,000 Operations Manager, Finance Manager and Chief Operating Officer

workflows.name: Supplier Invoice Processing
workflows.trigger: Practice Operations receives a supplier invoice for clinic supplies or equipment.
workflows.why: Manual handoff of supplier invoices risks misplaced documents and delayed payments. Automating invoice dispatch to Finance ensures timely tracking and payment within the 30-day window.

evidence.quote: Practice Operations sends each supplier invoice to Finance. The Accounts Officer matches it to the purchase order and pays the supplier within 30 days.

workflows.name: Clinician Rostering and Booking Setup
workflows.trigger: Clinical Services sends a roster request confirming a clinician's sessions.
workflows.output: Updated clinic rosters and booking system
workflows.why: Adding clinicians manually to schedules and booking systems is prone to scheduling conflicts and delays before start dates. Automating the ingestion of roster requests guarantees timely setup across clinic systems.

evidence.quote: The Clinical Director confirms the clinician's sessions and sends a roster request to Practice Operations, which adds the clinician to the clinic rosters and the booking system.

workflows.name: Patient Fee Refund Request and Approval
workflows.trigger: A Receptionist logs a refund request with the patient, invoice number, amount, and reason.
workflows.why: Reviewing refund requests and passing them between managers for approval causes delays for patients. Automating approval tiers based on refund thresholds accelerates turnaround and forwards approved claims directly to Finance.

evidence.quote: A Receptionist logs each refund request with the patient, the invoice number, the amount and the reason.
More than $500 Patient Services Manager and Finance Manager

workflows.name: Clinician Onboarding and Credentialing
workflows.trigger: A new clinician accepts an employment offer.
workflows.why: Checking registration and distributing clinician paperwork manually risks missing the ten-day onboarding deadline. Automation standardizes credential tracking and ensures verified details are dispatched on schedule.

evidence.quote: When a clinician accepts an offer, the HR Advisor checks their registration and sends the new clinician's details to Clinical Services at least ten business days before the start date.

workflows.name: Supplier Invoice Matching and Payment
workflows.trigger: Practice Operations sends a supplier invoice to Finance.
workflows.why: Matching paper or email invoices against purchase orders manually can cause delayed vendor payments and administrative overhead. Automating reconciliation streamlines verification and ensures payment within 30 days.

evidence.quote: Practice Operations sends each supplier invoice to Finance. The Accounts Officer matches it to the purchase order and pays the supplier within 30 days.

workflows.name: Patient Refund Payment Processing
workflows.trigger: Patient Services sends an approved refund request to Finance.
workflows.why: Processing refunds manually on card terminals is prone to processing backlogs. Automating the intake of approved refunds guarantees cards are credited within the mandatory 5 business days.

evidence.quote: Approved refunds go to Finance. The Accounts Officer refunds the patient's card within 5 business days.
